Scene: one majestic Indian mango tree with a winding coral-ochre trunk and dense individually outlined emerald and jade mango leaves, ripe golden mangoes with tiny dotted patterning. A charming Indian mother in a coral sari and a young child in pale blue sit on a low branch-side garden bench at the base, sharing a mango, naturally drawn in elegant folk-art style. Surround base with terracotta pots and marigold blooms, a small purple aubergine plant, a joyful basket of fruit. A yellow Indian sunbird perches at the top, tiny butterfly nearby. A poetic visual about family roots and returning to nature, not generic farm clip art. Tree branches and leaves fan out upward while human figures and little garden anchor the lower third.
